resources.string: Unofficial Grayjay modification for AYN Thor. Original software by FUTO. Reopen the app after changing the screen layout.
Video on the main display, Grayjay and playback controls on the smaller display.

START: play/pause. L1/R1: seek 10 seconds. The D-pad and A remain available for navigation.
